metadata.title: A Three-Layer Dependency-and-Logic Audit for Mathematical Proofs and AI-Generated Claims: The S/M/P × D/L Framework
metadata.description: We introduce a structured audit framework for mathematical proofs, conjectures, and AI-generated mathematical claims. The framework operates on three layers—Semantic, Mathematical, and Programming—and for each layer examines two complementary dimensions: internal Dependency relations and internal Logic-structure discipline. The resulting S/M/P × D/L matrix provides six elementary audit cells (S*D, S*L, M*D, M*L, P*D, P*L) plus cross-layer mapping checks. Version 12 extends the curated sample suite to 97 markdown reports by adding a historical-retrospective analysis of ten promising OpenAI/Lean-formalized samples: squarefree values of quartic polynomials, Jacobsthal quadratic bound, totient asymptotic formula, Gaussian-prime bounded components, planar graph L1 embeddings, graph switch Markov-chain mixing, three-dimensional periodic tiling counterexample (Einstein problem), Kazhdan–Lusztig combinatorial invariance, strong thin spanning trees, and the Tingley sphere isometry problem. For each sample the report identifies the closest classical constructions, the closest proven proof methods, and the places where human mathematicians still need to supply additional argument. The attached SMPDL_v2.3_sample_reports_97files.zip contains 97 markdown reports used to compute the joint SHA-256 fingerprint 3a365aff1760cb0ed3e48502886ebba53c71174af2d4f4bad9c7834af3504be2.
